objective: Keep production baselines viewable while preventing any result maintenance before the owning window reaches productionEnd.
users: Production managers reviewing and maintaining production-baseline results

requirements.statement: Window options must show status, production end time and the reason maintenance is unavailable while remaining selectable.
acceptance: An unfinished window option shows a second-line unavailable reason and can still load its baseline
requirements.source: User confirmed dropdown reason and view-only behavior on 2026-08-18
counterexample: The option only shows a status label with no reason
The unfinished window cannot be selected for viewing

requirements.statement: All frontend maintenance controls must be unavailable before the selected window ends while baseline data remains visible.
acceptance: Row selection, single maintenance and batch maintenance are disabled before productionEnd
A page-level reason identifies the opening time
requirements.source: User confirmed viewable but not maintainable
counterexample: A user can open the maintenance dialog before the window ends

requirements.statement: The maintenance boundary must be now greater than or equal to productionEnd using the Asia/Shanghai business-time interpretation.
acceptance: A fixed time before the boundary is denied
A fixed time exactly at the boundary is allowed
The frontend recomputes eligibility without requiring a new login
counterexample: Maintenance waits for a later CLOSED status
Maintenance is allowed one minute early

requirements.statement: Single and batch result APIs must enforce the owning window end time on the server without accepting client eligibility claims.
acceptance: Early direct API calls return conflict
No result update or audit append occurs on rejection
counterexample: Calling the API directly bypasses the UI restriction
Part of a rejected batch is persisted

requirements.statement: The rule must cover regular, urgent and emergency entries without changing existing result semantics, locking or audit behavior.
acceptance: Eligibility does not branch on versionType
Existing already-maintained, stale-version and field-validation tests remain green
counterexample: Emergency entries bypass the window gate
Existing result validation is reordered in a way that permits invalid writes

invariants: productionEnd comes from the tenant-scoped release window record
constraints: No API DTO or database change
Use existing Vue 3, Element Plus and Java Clock patterns

selected_approach.name: Frontend guidance plus server-enforced window gate
selected_approach.reason: It gives immediate user feedback and preserves integrity for direct API callers without expanding the public contract.

alternatives.name: Frontend-only gate
alternatives.rejected_because: Direct API calls can bypass it.

alternatives.name: New baseline eligibility response DTO
alternatives.rejected_because: The existing window DTO already supplies productionEnd and a contract change is unnecessary.

components.name: ReleaseBaselineView
components.responsibility: Show window availability reasons and disable every maintenance actuator before productionEnd.

components.name: ReleaseProductionService
components.responsibility: Enforce the owning tenant window productionEnd before any result update.

components.name: ReleaseProductionServiceTest
components.responsibility: Verify time boundaries, no-write rejection and existing result behavior with a fixed clock.

interfaces.name: Window eligibility
interfaces.contract: productionEnd is the comparison boundary; unfinished windows remain viewable.

interfaces.name: Result maintenance gate
interfaces.contract: A tenant-scoped owning window must exist and now must not be before productionEnd.

data_flows.input: Selected window and current frontend time

data_flows.output: Conflict without writes or the existing maintained result

error_handling.condition: Current server time is before productionEnd
error_handling.behavior: Return CONFLICT with the end time and do not update or append audit.
error_handling.recovery: Wait until the displayed end time or correct the window schedule through existing management.

error_handling.condition: Owning window cannot be found in the current tenant
error_handling.behavior: Return a business error and stop maintenance.
Server rejection wins and the API message is displayed.
error_handling.recovery: Refresh window data and retry after server time reaches the boundary.

security: Tenant-scoped server validation cannot be bypassed by the client
performance: One indexed window lookup per result entry within the existing 200-entry batch limit
compatibility: No request, response, database or route contract changes
operations: Business error includes the authoritative opening time

verification_strategy.signal: Fixed-clock service tests reject early writes, allow the exact boundary and preserve existing semantics.
verification_strategy.method: Focused and full ccb-release Maven tests with Mockito no-write verification.

verification_strategy.signal: Dropdown reasons and all maintenance controls match selected-window time while data stays visible.
verification_strategy.method: Frontend production build and authenticated desktop browser interaction.

verification_strategy.signal: No unauthorized files or broken governance contracts are introduced.
verification_strategy.method: Scope, governance and git diff checks with existing baseline failures disclosed.

assumptions.text: Browser and server clocks are normally close enough for minute-level presentation.
assumptions.basis: Both display and store window timestamps at minute precision.
assumptions.falsifier: A material client clock skew makes the UI enable maintenance before the server boundary.

decisions.decision: Unfinished windows remain selectable and viewable.
decisions.reason: Managers still need process visibility before completion.

decisions.decision: All version types use the same window-end gate.
decisions.reason: The confirmed design contains no emergency exception.
decisions.source: User confirmation of the complete design on 2026-08-18.

decisions.decision: The exact productionEnd instant is maintainable.
decisions.reason: The requirement forbids maintenance only while the end time has not arrived.

risks.risk: Client clock skew can temporarily disagree with the server.
risks.impact: A control may appear enabled but the server rejects it.
risks.mitigation: Keep the server authoritative and show its error; update frontend time every minute.

risks.risk: A malformed batch contains entries from different windows.
risks.mitigation: Validate every entry inside the existing transaction so any failure rolls back the batch.

approval.evidence: The user reviewed the landed design and explicitly requested development.
